algorithm.help: Quoting algorithm. algo1: distance grid, fill probabilities and expected value. algo3: order-book imbalance, microprice and a fixed spread. A Demo worker switches at its next round; a live worker reads it when it is started.

algo3_depth_k.help: Book levels on each side that enter the imbalance.

algo3_decay_rho.help: Weight of each deeper level in the imbalance, rho^i (1 = every level counts the same).

algo3_beta.help: Lean of the quote centre per unit of imbalance, as a fraction of price (0 = microprice centre only, until beta is estimated from data).

algo3_half_spread.help: Half-spread around the centre, as a fraction of price. 0 = the smallest half-spread that clears the fee bar, plus one tick.

algo3_min_volume_orders.help: A top of book thinner than this many order sizes carries no signal: imbalance 0, centre at the mid. 0 = always trust the book.

algo3_imbalance_clip.help: Largest imbalance the lean may use (0.8 = one spoofed level cannot push the lean to its maximum).
